name: 初半馬完賽｜21 公里 12 週
for: 已經有跑步習慣、能連續跑 5 公里，想在有結構的規劃下，安全、有信心地完成人生第一場半程馬拉松。
for_en: You already run regularly and can run 5K non-stop, and want a structured plan to finish your first half marathon safely and confidently.

includes.zh: 每週 4 次跑步，全部以閾值配速百分比設定，自動換算成你的個人配速
includes.en: 4 runs a week, all set as % of threshold pace and converted to your own paces

includes.zh: 第 1、8 週 5 公里配速測驗，設定並更新你的配速區間
includes.en: 5K pace tests in weeks 1 and 8 to set and update your zones

includes.zh: 第 1–11 週肌力訓練，附動作示範影片與中文說明
includes.en: Strength training in weeks 1–11 with demo videos

includes.zh: 跑前動態暖身、肌力課活動度熱身與長跑後伸展
includes.en: Dynamic warm-ups, mobility prep, and post-long-run stretching

includes.zh: 每週階段說明、裝備選用清單與賽前通知事項
includes.en: Weekly phase notes, gear checklist, and race-week briefing

phases.name: 第 1–4 週
phases.desc: 基礎期：建立規律練跑與有氧基礎，第 4 週減量
phases.desc_en: Base: consistent running and aerobic base, recovery in week 4

phases.name: 第 5–8 週
phases.desc: 進展期：加入節奏跑，拉長週末長跑
phases.desc_en: Build: tempo runs and longer weekend runs

phases.name: 第 9–10 週
phases.desc: 巔峰期：最長距離與比賽配速練習
phases.desc_en: Peak: longest runs and race-pace work

phases.name: 第 11–12 週
phases.desc: 減量與比賽週：保持狀態，帶著新鮮的腿上場
phases.desc_en: Taper & race week: stay sharp, race on fresh legs

name: 5 公里速度挑戰｜8 週
for: 已經能跑完 5 公里，想突破個人最佳成績，或成績停滯、想加入有系統的速度訓練。
for_en: You can already run 5K and want to set a new personal best with structured speed work.

includes.zh: 每週 4 跑：間歇、節奏或閾值、輕鬆跑＋加速跑、長跑
includes.en: 4 runs a week: intervals, tempo/threshold, easy + strides, long run

includes.zh: 5K 配速、閾值與最大攝氧間歇，全部以閾值配速百分比設定
includes.en: 5K-pace, threshold, and VO2max work, all set as % of threshold pace

includes.zh: 第 1 週起點測驗、第 8 週速度挑戰，前後對照看見進步
includes.en: Baseline test in week 1 and 5K challenge in week 8 to measure progress

includes.zh: 每堂課附中文說明與教練提醒，每週附階段說明
includes.en: Every session includes notes and coaching cues, plus weekly phase notes

phases.name: 第 1–3 週
phases.desc: 基礎期：5K 配速間歇與節奏跑，熟悉目標配速
phases.desc_en: Base: 5K-pace intervals and tempo, learn your goal pace

phases.name: 第 4 週
phases.desc: 恢復週：降低強度，吸收前三週的訓練
phases.desc_en: Recovery: lower intensity to absorb training

phases.name: 第 5–7 週
phases.desc: 強化期：最大攝氧間歇、閾值拉長與比賽模擬
phases.desc_en: Build: VO2max, longer threshold, and race simulation

phases.name: 第 8 週
phases.desc: 比賽週：減量後挑戰新的個人最佳
phases.desc_en: Race week: taper, then chase a new PB

name: 初鐵完賽｜51.5 標準距離 12 週
for: 會游、會騎、會跑，但還沒比過鐵人三項，想安全、有把握地完成第一場 51.5。
for_en: You can swim, bike, and run, and want to finish your first Olympic-distance race safely and confidently.

includes.zh: 游泳、自行車、跑步三項均衡的週期化課表
includes.en: Balanced, periodized swim–bike–run plan

includes.zh: 轉換區與連續項目（Brick）練習
includes.en: Transition and brick sessions

includes.zh: 心率與自覺強度雙指標，沒有功率計也能練
includes.en: Heart rate and RPE targets — no power meter needed

includes.zh: 賽前一週減量與比賽日流程指引
includes.en: Race-week taper and race-day checklist

phases.name: 第 1–4 週
phases.desc: 基礎期：建立三項的有氧底子與規律
phases.desc_en: Base: aerobic foundation and routine

phases.name: 第 5–9 週
phases.desc: 進展期：加入比賽配速與連續項目
phases.desc_en: Build: race pace and brick work

phases.name: 第 10–12 週
phases.desc: 巔峰與減量：模擬比賽，帶著新鮮的腿上場
phases.desc_en: Peak & taper: race simulation, fresh legs

name: IRONMAN 70.3｜113 公里 16 週
for: 已完成過標鐵或 70.3，想在下一場 113 穩定配速、後段不崩的選手。
for_en: You've raced Olympic or 70.3 and want to pace your next half steadily without fading late.

includes.zh: 以功率／配速／心率設定強度區間
includes.en: Power, pace, and heart-rate based zones

includes.zh: 每 4 週一次檢測課，追蹤進步
includes.en: Test sessions every 4 weeks to track progress

includes.zh: 長距離騎乘接跑的比賽配速練習
includes.en: Race-pace long ride + run combinations

includes.zh: 賽中補給策略與腸胃訓練安排
includes.en: Race fueling strategy and gut training

phases.name: 第 1–5 週
phases.desc: 基礎期：有氧量與技術
phases.desc_en: Base: aerobic volume and technique

phases.name: 第 6–12 週
phases.desc: 進展期：閾值與 70.3 比賽強度
phases.desc_en: Build: threshold and 70.3 race intensity

phases.name: 第 13–14 週
phases.desc: 巔峰期：比賽模擬與補給演練
phases.desc_en: Peak: race simulation and fueling rehearsal

phases.name: 第 15–16 週
phases.desc: 減量期：保持強度、降低總量
phases.desc_en: Taper: keep intensity, cut volume

name: IRONMAN 226｜超級鐵人 20 週
for: 準備 226 公里全程超級鐵人，需要一份能兼顧工作、又撐得起長距離訓練量的計畫。
for_en: You're preparing for a full IRONMAN and need a plan that supports big volume alongside a full-time job.

includes.zh: 以續航力（Durability）為核心的長距離安排
includes.en: Long sessions built around durability

includes.zh: 週末長騎、長跑與比賽配速的漸進設計
includes.en: Progressive weekend long ride/run at race pace

includes.zh: 恢復週節奏，降低受傷與過度訓練風險
includes.en: Recovery-week rhythm to reduce injury and overtraining risk

includes.zh: 完整比賽日配速、補給與轉換區計畫
includes.en: Full race-day pacing, fueling, and transition plan

phases.name: 第 1–6 週
phases.desc: 基礎期：逐步堆疊三項訓練量
phases.desc_en: Base: build volume across all three sports

phases.name: 第 7–15 週
phases.desc: 進展期：長距離比賽配速與續航力
phases.desc_en: Build: long race-pace work and durability

phases.name: 第 16–17 週
phases.desc: 巔峰期：最長訓練日與補給總彩排
phases.desc_en: Peak: biggest days and full fueling rehearsal

phases.name: 第 18–20 週
phases.desc: 減量期：三週漸進減量，比賽日滿血出發
phases.desc_en: Taper: three-week taper into race day

name: 全程馬拉松｜16 週
for: 完成過半馬或全馬，想用結構化訓練挑戰新的個人最佳成績。
for_en: You've run a half or full marathon and want a structured plan to chase a new PR.

includes.zh: 依目標完賽時間設定配速區間
includes.en: Pace zones set from your goal finish time

includes.zh: 長跑、節奏跑與間歇的週期化組合
includes.en: Periodized long runs, tempo, and intervals

includes.zh: 肌力與跑姿輔助訓練
includes.en: Supporting strength and form work

includes.zh: 比賽日配速與補給策略
includes.en: Race-day pacing and fueling

phases.name: 第 1–5 週
phases.desc: 基礎期：有氧跑量與肌力
phases.desc_en: Base: aerobic mileage and strength

phases.name: 第 6–13 週
phases.desc: 進展期：馬拉松配速長跑與閾值
phases.desc_en: Build: marathon-pace long runs and threshold

phases.name: 第 14–16 週
phases.desc: 減量期：降低跑量、維持節奏感
phases.desc_en: Taper: lower mileage, keep sharpness
